name: ai-dancing
description: Phù Thuỷ AI - Bẻ cong timeline

scripts.build: npm install && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.build:landing: npm install && npm --workspace landing run build
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 --log-level error --no-access-log
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.clean: npm --workspace frontend run clean && npm --workspace landing run clean && cd backend && find . -type d -name '__pycache__' -exec rm -r {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -name '*.pyc' -delete 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .pytest_cache 2>/dev/null
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules && cd frontend && rm -rf node_modules && cd ../landing && rm -rf node_modules && cd ..
